title: evidence.ledger
description: An append-only record of gate verdicts and their declared provenance. A node may transition verifying -> completed only when its latest active passing entry declares assurance external, or gate_kind human_approval. These fields do not establish that the evidence content is adequate or correct. Field names and enum values are locked byte-for-byte per references/state_model.md (evidence.ledger).

entry_id.description: Unique id of the ledger entry.

node_id.description: The node the verdict is for.

score.description: Numeric score for scored gates (0..1), or null for pass/fail gates.

artifact_path.description: Path to the evidence artifact this entry attests.

producer_claim_path.description: For assurance blind, path to the producer claim read only after the reviewer verdict is recorded. R47 compares this file's mtime with artifact_path for ordering only; the comparison does not establish blindness or independence.

recorded.description: When the entry was recorded (ISO-8601 date-time).

assurance.description: Declared verdict provenance only; this does not establish evidence adequacy or correctness.

success_criteria_id.description: Optional citation to loop.plan.success_criteria[].id. R45 checks only that a present citation resolves; resolution does not establish criterion satisfaction or evidence adequacy.

overrides_entry_id.description: Optional entry_id of a prior verdict this overriding entry overrides. For a completed node with an active blind failure, R48 also requires a dissent event for the node.

supersedes.description: entry_id of a prior ledger entry this entry corrects/supersedes, or null. Lets 'latest entry governs' pick the correction rather than the stale verdict.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this evidence entry. Evidence is not a permanent fact; it can be superseded by a re-run, invalidated when its artifact is deleted/disproven, go stale past a freshness window, or be retired with its node. Only 'active' evidence may back an active gate (rule R38). Defaults to 'active' when omitted.

superseded_by.description: entry_id of the newer entry that replaces this one (set when status is 'superseded'). Must reference an existing entry.
